turns.instruction:
Analyze the fixed-base frame, 6 m span and 4 m height, roof -Z 6 kN/m and right-top +X 50 kN. Report global Ux and Uz at the highest-story rightmost beam-column joint, and global support moment My and vertical reaction Fz at the left base, for every listed case and combination.
Use the stated OpenSees engine for every computable changed state. First-order linear elastic analysis; self-weight, P-delta, rigid diaphragms, rigid offsets and construction stages are off. Preserve all fields not explicitly changed. Report every requested signed value with node/member, global direction, unit, case/combination, turn, model state and traceable . Rz denotes the vertical support reaction Fz. Retain original cases and evaluate every listed combination separately. Resolve essential missing or contradictory inputs before reporting new numerical results.

Replace the right-top +X 50 kN force with +X 80 kN. Preserve all gravity and other inputs; recompute. Report global Ux and Uz at the highest-story rightmost beam-column joint, and global support moment My and vertical reaction Fz at the left base, for every listed case and combination.
